correctness.rationale: PASS: Correct strict halo criterion 3|I∩E|>2|I| iff e(I)>2z(I). A deletion-minimal circular arc subcover of all unmarked vertices is at most a two-cover by the common-point triple-arc redundancy lemma. Consequently 2k>=sum e_j>=2sum z_j+m>=2z+m, excluding k<=z. At N=4q+3, k=2q+2 and z odd, equality forces exactly two arcs each including every marked vertex and exactly half the z unmarked vertices, contradiction. k=floor(N/2)+1+1_{N≡3 mod4} consecutive markers works: for each site in gap choose a side to traverse all k markers plus at most ceil(z/2) missing markers, yielding k>2ceil(z/2). For even N checkerboard markers give 2/3 three-site averages but not strictly above threshold. Independent exact bitmask enumeration checked N=3..12 minima and constructions and verified arc triple-cover property in bounded cases. Infinite N follows from combinatorial argument.
